recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is because current core source satisfies FHIR-6239. Any future DICOM URL modernization should be handled as a separate editorial/link-policy task rather than as part of this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-6239 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for ImagingStudy. It asked for an introductory legend explaining parenthetical identifiers in ImagingStudy descriptions, with the accepted resolution expanding Scope and Usage to describe DICOM Attribute tags and link to appropriate DICOM publication material.
initial_application: Historical commit 2a416c3e03 explicitly mentioned 6239 in an ImagingStudy/ImagingObjectSelection omnibus update and adjusted DICOM-related introduction text. The full current legend was added shortly afterward by commit 420e76081f under the related FHIR-7679 change family, whose Jira resolution included the exact DICOM tag explanation and DICOM Part 3/4/6 links.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists imagingstudy=ImagingStudy in the active resources section, so the inspected source is in current build scope. The current StructureDefinition still has DICOM mapping rows with parenthetical tags, and later R6 work such as FHIR-54781 adjusted individual mapping text without changing the need or wording for the legend. Exact and broader Zulip/Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-introduction.xml lines 28-36 already explain that DICOM attributes are 32-bit tags shown as two four-digit hexadecimal values in parentheses, give example (0008,103E), and link to DICOM Part 6, Part 3, and Part 4 Annex C.

related_jiras.note: Its resolution included the exact DICOM tag legend text that now satisfies the FHIR-6239 request, though its main issue request was a separate ImagingStudy use-case update.
A later Applied R6 ImagingStudy DICOM mapping correction confirms continued maintenance of individual mapping rows without changing the tag legend.
